progress.baseReset: Uncompleted progress is reset before the next base spin.
progress.bonusRetention: Progress survives between free spins; base-game progress is not transferred into the bonus.
progress.featureTiming: Earned features resolve after the current winning cascade sequence; bonus rules explicitly resolve active features before the next free spin.

features.name: Paw of Fortune
features.mechanic: The progress display becomes a growing multiplier bar. Cascade wins use its current multiplier; arriving multiplier-symbol values are added to the bar.

features.name: Scarab Storm
features.mechanic: Multiplier symbols remain on the grid through this feature sequence. At its end, their combined value multiplies the total wins accumulated during the feature.

features.name: Rising Wings
features.mechanic: Multiplier symbols appear at random grid positions. Their summed multiplier applies to each cascade win during the feature and resets when the feature finishes.

features.name: Fate Strike
features.mechanic: Grid-cell multipliers start at 2. Wins involving those cells use the stated sum of multipliers; multipliers on involved cells increase after wins and remain attached to fixed positions for later cascades.
features.unresolved: Help does not specify the numerical increment or fully disambiguate whether the summed multiplier includes only the winning cells or every marked cell.

features.name: Eye of the Sky
features.mechanic: Choose an ordinary symbol type and replace all its visible instances with Wilds. Scatter and Wild cannot be the chosen type. Resulting wins use the current multiplier.

featureSelection.behavior: Chosen feature activates on every spin while selected, replacing the normal progress sequence. Mode changes are allowed only before a new spin, never mid-round or during its bonus.

multiplierSymbols.note: Values and feature descriptions are public; their probabilities and selection distributions are not provided.
